title: Brevity Command Result v1
description: Permissive schema for future machine-readable Brevity command results. This contract is designed for additive evolution: producers may add fields over time, and consumers should tolerate unknown fields.

schema.description: Identifies this document as a Brevity command result contract payload.

command.description: Identifies the Brevity command that produced the result, such as 'task cleanup' or 'provider set'.

success.description: Machine-readable command outcome. True indicates the command completed without fatal errors; warnings may still be present.

severity.description: Highest result severity. Consumers can use this to distinguish successful results, successful results with warnings, and failed commands.

warnings.description: Non-fatal issues that should be visible to the operator without requiring consumers to parse human console output.

errors.description: Fatal issues that prevented completion. Failed commands should explain the blocking condition here in machine-readable form where practical.

suggestedNextActions.description: Safe follow-up hints for TUI and runtime consumers, such as refreshing runtime state after a mutation. Unknown action names should be tolerated.

payload.description: Optional command-specific structured result data. Nested payloads are intentionally permissive so commands can evolve additively without breaking older consumers.

message.description: Operator-visible warning or error detail. Strings are allowed for lightweight early adoption; objects allow future structured codes and metadata.

code.description: Optional stable machine-readable warning or error code.

details.description: Optional structured context for the warning or error.
